reference.lookReference: compact-on-lcd.png (the supplied SVG on the LCD background #edf0f4)

blender: 5.2.1 LTS. Scene built through Blender MCP from scripts/blender/build-oxhack-compact.py, rendered headless with EEVEE from the saved .blend
artwork: Supplied SVG flattened to contours (extract-oxhack-logo.py) and extruded in layers: navy back ring, 60% alpha glass panel, bevelled frame, traces, pads and hex labels, block letters with white faces. Surfaces are unlit emission shaders, so the rest pose keeps the logo's colours; shape, glints and rim come from the surface normal and vanish facing the camera. The SVG's mix-blend-mode:color overlays are not in the contours, so frame, trace and block colours use 25-stop ramps measured from the look reference along the SVG gradient axes. The glass uses the plain SVG gradient. Sparks on the pads, the spin, glints and the power-on are additions to the supplied logo.

delivery.color: RGB555-style quantization; soft alpha quantized to 5 bits with alpha under 8 cleared; nearest-neighbour display
delivery.playback: Intro frames 1-104 once per selection, then frames 105-200 loop as an idle sway; frame 104 immediately for reduced motion. poster.png is frame 200, which matches frame 104 after compositing.
delivery.motion: Frames 1-84: spin about a precessing tilted near-vertical axis, leftward, decaying from 6.6 rev/s through 6.6 revolutions; motion blur shutter .55 fading to none by frame 56. Dolly zoom from 62mm to 135mm from frame 44. Frames 42-82: block letters rise out of the glass in staggered order O X year H A C K, seen mirrored through the glass as the back passes. Frame 44 begins the last 40-frame turn. Frame 84: lands face-on with a damped overshoot and scale thunk, settled by frame 101. Frames 85-93: twin pulses run the frame from the apex. Frames 90-96: the charge runs inward along the traces. Frames 92-102: a sweep switches the letters to white. Frames 94-101: pads flash and spark. Frames 102-104 hold the rest pose. Frames 105-200: sway with yaw .22 rad, pitch .05 rad and .05 unit bob, holding on the logo at the seam.
